endorsements.name: Matt Slotten
endorsements.label: API Threat Landscape: How to Remediate API Vulnerabilities Faster
endorsements.description: API security has always been a problem and recent years have seen rapid growth in the use of APIs when building modern applications. Their proliferation represents a significant viable attack surface area for would-be attackers and real-world evidence suggest that up to 70% of organizations have experienced an API breach in the last year. Existing API security solutions such as Web Application Firewalls and API Gateways can only monitor and protect API endpoints of which they are aware. Through scanning applications at the source and comparing to API documentation, we can discover, inventory, and identify vulnerabilities exposed through application APIs and remediate those vulnerabilities earlier in the development process using a true “shift-left” approach.
